landing.title: GitHub Actions insights and management, self-hosted
landing.intro: DevOps Manager connects to your repositories through one GitHub App and shows runs, durations, queue times, runners and costs across a personal account and organisations.
landing.privacy: Normalised run and job metadata, logins of GitHub actors, the email, name and groups snapshot of app users, and audit entries. Raw run data is kept for 90 days by default; daily summaries are kept. Logs and secrets are never stored.
landing.selfHost: Deploy on Vercel with Neon, or run it with Docker Compose.

dialog.confirmIgnore: {count, plural, one {I understand that the stored data of this repository is deleted.} other {I understand that the stored data of these # repositories is deleted.}}
dialog.confirmUnignore: {count, plural, one {Import the history of this repository again.} other {Import the history of these # repositories again.}}
dialog.submitUnignore: {count, plural, one {Stop ignoring} other {Stop ignoring # repositories}}

result.ignored: {count, plural, one {# repository ignored.} other {# repositories ignored.}} Stored data is being deleted.
result.unignored: {count, plural, one {# repository is loaded again.} other {# repositories are loaded again.}} A fresh history import will start.
